note: barters is npc/barters.yml with its imports for the mode, as BarterDatabase loads it, sorted by name. A barter is a shop opened by callshop with its name. file is the file that first names it. map is null for a barter that is not on a map, and x and y are then 0. dir is rAthena's direction, 0 north, then counterclockwise. sprite is the Sprite constant as written, or null for JT_FAKENPC, which shows nothing. items are sorted by index. stock 0 is unlimited, and a stock above 0 is the stock the shop starts with (rAthena keeps the stock in its barter table). zeny is the zeny each one costs. refine is the refine of the item it gives. required lists the items it takes, sorted by index: amount for each one bought, and refine -1 for any refine. A required refine of 0 or more takes an item of that refine, or a higher one when none matches (npc_barter_purchase). extended is set for a barter that needs feature.barter_extended, as BarterDatabase::loadingFinished decides. buying_store lists the items whose item_db Flags.BuyingStore is true, which a buying store may buy. settings are the vending, store search and mail settings: the battle settings after conf/battle_athena.conf and its imports, as battle_config_read, with battle.cpp's default, min and max for the mode, and mail_return_days, mail_delete_days and mail_return_empty from conf/char_athena.conf and its imports, as char_config_read.
